test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the sales of two companies A and B in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77cc0eb8f4974861e34acd4a565a37491b9a5710a4dbb310875adebf02b1f59d.png] 

J1 = The total sales of A in all years.

J2 = The total sales of B in all years.

What is the value of (J2 - J1)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

J1 = The total sales of A in all years = (150 + 350 + 550 + 450 + 250)

⇒ 1750

J2 = The total sales of B in all years = (950 + 650 + 750 + 150 + 50)

⇒ 2550

J2 - J1 = 2550 - 1750

⇒ 800

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
